title: Microsoft.Entra/applications/passwordCredentials
description: A client secret of an application. The child name is the credential displayName. Secrets are created with addPassword and removed with removePassword (never edited); the secret text is returned once as a securestring output.

displayName.description: Set from the resource name; declaring it is only allowed when it equals the name.

startDateTime.description: Start of validity (ISO 8601, UTC); defaults to now.

endDateTime.description: Expiry (ISO 8601, UTC); defaults to 180 days after creation, evaluated once at create.

rotationTag.description: EntraARM-only: changing this value rotates the secret (the new one is added before the old one is removed). Never sent to Graph.

rotateBeforeDays.description: EntraARM-only: rotate when fewer than this many days remain (default 30). Never sent to Graph.
